confirmed.statement: S1 alone reports 120 analyzed people across its two randomized arms, exceeding the 50-person requirement without pooling the pilot, repeated assessments or output counts.

summary: The PDF supports 120 randomized and analyzed music students in S1, with 60 per arm, so the people-count coding is not refuted and criterion 2 holds. The separate 28-student pilot and output/rater counts are not added; attrition and cross-paper sample reuse are not reported.
